title: Anybody with mobile phone is a journalist today: Delhi High Court calls for law to regulate media
description: Freedom of press cannot be a shield for irresponsible journalism, intimidation and jeopardizing public order, the Delhi High Court observed on July 16.Justice Girish Kathpalia also lamented that anybody with a mobile phone call themselves journalists today without any accountability.“Today, virtually anyone armed with a mobile phone and a microphone can proclaim themselves to be a “reporter”, often without any journalistic training, ethical grounding, or accountability,” the Court observed.There
